# Omdan Development Inc
> Licensed general contractor serving Palm Springs, the Coachella Valley, and the Inland Empire, CA.
> CSLB License #1148568

## About
Omdan Development Inc is a licensed and insured contractor based in Palm Springs, California. The company provides residential and light commercial construction, landscaping, plumbing, and handyman services across Southern California's Coachella Valley and Inland Empire regions. David leads the crew and is personally involved in every project.

## Services

### Outdoor & Hardscaping
- Paver Installation (driveways, patios, pool decks, walkways, courtyards): https://omdandevelopment.com/pavers/
- Concrete Work (driveways, slabs, patios, pool decks, repairs): https://omdandevelopment.com/concrete/
- Artificial Turf Installation (front yards, backyards, pet turf, putting greens, pool surrounds): https://omdandevelopment.com/artificial-turf/
- Gravel & Xeriscape (low-water desert landscaping, decomposed granite): https://omdandevelopment.com/gravel/
- Exterior Painting: https://omdandevelopment.com/exterior-painting/
